text_a: The accounting team must approve every refund over 500 dollars.
text_b: Every refund over 500 dollars must be approved by the accounting team.

text_a: El supervisor debe aprobar las horas extra del equipo.
text_b: El equipo debe aprobar las horas extra del supervisor.
what_differs: Roles swapped: who approves and whose overtime is approved.

text_a: Depois de cada turno, o técnico deve registrar as falhas.
text_b: O técnico deve registrar as falhas depois de cada turno.

text_a: Customers must be notified by the agent before the warranty expires.
text_b: The agent must be notified by customers before the warranty expires.
what_differs: Who notifies whom is reversed.

text_a: Las facturas vencidas las revisa el área de cobranza cada lunes.
text_b: El área de cobranza revisa cada lunes las facturas vencidas.

text_a: O gerente não aprovou todos os pedidos.
text_b: Todos os pedidos não foram aprovados pelo gerente.
what_differs: Scope of negation: some orders unapproved versus none approved.

text_a: In case of a data breach, the legal team must be informed within an hour.
text_b: The legal team must be informed within an hour in case of a data breach.

text_a: La directora entrega los boletines a los padres en la reunión.
text_b: Los padres entregan los boletines a la directora en la reunión.
what_differs: Giver and receiver of the report cards are swapped.

text_a: Every employee must complete the security course.
text_b: All employees must complete the security course.

text_a: Todos los pedidos deben llevar la firma del cliente.
text_b: Algunos pedidos deben llevar la firma del cliente.
what_differs: All orders versus only some orders need a signature.

text_a: Nenhum aluno pode sair da sala antes do sinal.
text_b: Não pode sair da sala nenhum aluno antes do sinal.

text_a: Each invoice must have a purchase order number.
text_b: Some invoices must have a purchase order number.
what_differs: Each invoice versus only some invoices.

text_a: Cada cajero debe contar su caja al cerrar.
text_b: Todos los cajeros deben contar su caja al cerrar.

text_a: Not every driver needs a hazmat card.
text_b: Every driver does not need a hazmat card.
what_differs: Second text can mean no driver needs one, or only some do.

text_a: Nenhum cliente deve receber o desconto.
text_b: Nem todo cliente deve receber o desconto.
what_differs: No customer versus not every customer gets the discount.

text_a: None of the tickets may be closed without a customer reply.
text_b: No ticket may be closed without a customer reply.

text_a: Cada candidato debe aportar como mínimo tres referencias.
text_b: Cada candidato debe aportar al menos tres referencias.

text_a: Warehouse staff may lift at most 20 kilos alone.
text_b: Warehouse staff may lift at least 20 kilos alone.
what_differs: Upper bound turned into lower bound.

text_a: O fornecedor pode entregar no máximo cinco paletes por visita.
text_b: O fornecedor pode entregar até cinco paletes por visita.

text_a: A equipe pode estacionar no local, a menos que haja evento com visitantes.
text_b: A equipe pode estacionar no local, se não houver evento com visitantes.

text_a: Se reembolsan todos los gastos excepto las bebidas alcohólicas.
text_b: Se reembolsan todos los gastos incluidas las bebidas alcohólicas.
what_differs: Alcoholic drinks excluded versus included.

text_a: Do not escalate tickets unless the customer asks.
text_b: Escalate tickets if the customer asks.
what_differs: Second text does not say whether escalation is forbidden otherwise.

text_a: Solo el administrador puede cambiar los permisos.
text_b: Nadie excepto el administrador puede cambiar los permisos.

text_a: Only the day manager may sign delivery notes.
text_b: The day manager may sign delivery notes.
what_differs: Exclusivity dropped; others may now sign.

text_a: Aceitamos apenas pagamentos em dinheiro.
text_b: Aceitamos somente pagamentos em dinheiro.

text_a: Do not share your login with colleagues.
text_b: Don't share your login with colleagues.

text_a: Nunca se debe dejar la caja abierta.
text_b: No siempre se debe dejar la caja abierta.
what_differs: Never versus not always.

text_a: Nunca deixe o cofre aberto.
text_b: Não deixe o cofre aberto.
what_differs: Never could be a permanent rule, the plain negative could be about this occasion.

text_a: If the server is down, call the on-call engineer.
text_b: Call the on-call engineer if the server is down.

text_a: Se cancela el recreo si llueve.
text_b: Se cancela el recreo a menos que llueva.
what_differs: If it rains versus unless it rains: opposite conditions.

text_a: A menos que o formulário esteja assinado, não o processe.
text_b: Se o formulário não estiver assinado, não o processe.

text_a: Order twenty chairs for the training room.
text_b: Order 20 chairs for the training room.

text_a: Transfiera 1.000 euros a la cuenta de reserva.
text_b: Transfiera 1,000 euros a la cuenta de reserva.
what_differs: Separator conventions differ: one thousand or one euro.

text_a: Cada caixa deve pesar 20 kg.
text_b: Cada caixa deve pesar 20 g.
what_differs: Kilograms versus grams.

text_a: Submit the timesheet no later than Friday noon.
text_b: Submit the timesheet by Friday noon.

text_a: Entreguen el informe antes del viernes.
text_b: Entreguen el informe después del viernes.
what_differs: Before versus after Friday.

text_a: Responda ao cliente até sexta-feira.
text_b: Responda ao cliente antes de sexta-feira.
what_differs: Whether Friday itself is still allowed.

text_a: Restart the router after the update.
text_b: Reboot the router after the update.

text_a: Elimine los archivos temporales del servidor.
text_b: Copie los archivos temporales del servidor.
what_differs: Delete versus copy: files are removed or kept.

text_a: Gere um relatório mensal de vendas.
text_b: Crie um relatório mensal de vendas.
